reason: A DeepSeek Harness vision toolkit that provides image Q&A, OCR, grounding, image processing, UI restoration support, pixel comparison, and HTML screenshot rendering with structured artifacts.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供图像问答、OCR、定位、图像处理、像素对比和 HTML 截图等视觉工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with image Q&A, OCR, grounding, image processing, pixel comparison, and HTML screenshot tools.

capabilities: image understanding through a configured vision API
local image cropping, tracing, color analysis, foreground extraction, and pixel comparison
HTML screenshot rendering through a local browser adapter
workspace artifact creation and file delivery
